recent_milestones.text: User-directed document-first screening activated: each main article and SI can proceed without prior pairing.13,831fixed copies mapped to12,136distinct content tasks;1,695duplicate copies retained. Existing source reading is reused, not reset. Daily schedule preserved and successive batches requested. No scientific records or screening completions added by this queue change.

Parallel Methods-first screening added 76 provisional scope checks (69 with usable preparation information; 7 deferred or held), plus reuse of one already-closed news scope. 97 provisional scopes now have tracked source-screen receipts, including aliases. Separate bounded checks passed for both mixed batches and the prior second atomic shortlist; selected phase candidates were spot-checked. No new scientific records or exact training pairs were published.

Daily review schedule preserved. First eight shortlisted articles passed a separate bounded synthesis/structure screening audit. A second eight-study batch identified two studies with printed product-coordinate candidates; independent audit and training admission remain pending.

Workflow simplified at user request: Methods/relevant SI first, structure evidence second. Unreadable files are deferred without blocking readable candidates. Full per-paper audits remain required for published data; no new training pairs claimed.

Corrected automated screen audited: 9,532 provisional groups, 13,831 copies and three nested identity holds. Nominations: 52 atomic-evidence, 655 phase-link and 433 morphology-link groups. All 238 manual format/text cases are retained for further screening. No scientific records or training pairs were added.

Workflow changed at the user’s request: screen every source in the fixed collection for usable synthesis–structure pairs before further website builds. Chen source extraction passed its independent audit; Saini complete main/SI extraction is preserved for later audit. No new scientific records published.

User set an October22completion target for the fixed collection. Capacity requirement:317final dispositions/day across30days, or approximately400/day with calibration/repair reserve. Duplicate source payload candidates are undergoing content-aware review; identical error responses cannot merge distinct intended papers or count as scientific completion. No paid processing or new scientific publication in this update.

Review resumed after the website revision. The fixed-cutoff ranking was refreshed and two main/SI bundles were assigned: Saini2023 carbon dots and Chen2018 perovskite composites. Original source names and hashes are preserved; 3,136 later-arrival scopes remain separate. No additional scientific records are published in this progress update.

Sasongko FAPbI3 contribution published and anonymously verified: 19 records, 21 illustrated operations and 17 selected source crops. Nine paired comparisons and reference-versus-measured structure limits remain explicit. Active work is complete; the remaining corpus is paused for joint review.

Friedfeld InP cluster-to-QD contribution published and anonymously verified: four conversion routes, 58 illustrated operations and 51 selected original crops. Labeled ligand synthesis, kinetics and source conflicts retain their own scope. Dataset 0.32.0 has 656 records and 122 routes/variants; no new training admission or exact atomic pair.

Pati CeO2-related precipitation contribution published and anonymously verified: three separate alcohol routes,35illustrated operation instances and20original source crops. Local CeO2 microscopy, unresolved as-prepared bulk composition, calcined powder and XPS exposure contexts remain distinct. Dataset0.31.0 contains626records and118routes/variants; no new training admission or exact atomic pair.

Matuhina CsMnCl₃ contribution published and anonymously verified: five paired hot-injection conditions, 39 illustrated stages, 30 original source crops and separately assigned structure, optical, aging and device specimens. Dataset0.30.0 contains607records and115routes/variants. Complete supplied main and matched SI reviewed; source contradictions remain explicit.

Matuhina and Pati complete supplied main/SI source extractions passed separate audits. Matuhina structured data/reader, 39 apparatus scenes and 47 symbolic product-context mappings also passed their scoped audits. These private proposals remain outside the live scientific dataset pending remaining website gates.

Sommer ZnAl₂O₄ contribution published and anonymously verified: three laboratory routes, 31 illustrated stages, 20 selected original crops and sample-specific phase outcomes. Complete supplied main reviewed; SI unverified. Dataset 0.29.0 contains 586 records and 114 routes/variants. Matuhina CsMnCl₃ main/SI extraction and independent audit continue.

Ghosh CdSe/CdS contribution published and anonymously verified: five synthesis routes/variants, 33 illustrated operations, 36 selected source crops and separately scoped structure/property evidence. Dataset 0.28.0 has 567 records and 111 routes/variants. Sommer ZnAl₂O₄ source extraction and independent review continue.

Lian antimony-halide contribution published and anonymously verified: three synthesis routes or variants, 21 illustrated operations, 53 selected source crops and two qualified partial bulk-crystal views. Dataset 0.27.0 contains 546 records, 106 routes and 46 material/component pages.

Lian complete source and structured-data audits passed; illustrations remain under review. The completed Morrison slot was refilled with Ghosh (2012), on giant CdSe/CdS quantum dots. Both retain distinct review and publication gates.

Morrison CdSe/CdS contribution published and anonymously verified: 2 synthesis routes, 8 supporting procedures and 8 observation records. Dataset 0.26.0 has 530 records, 103 routes/variants and 44 material/component hubs.

The completed Evans slot was refilled from the screened fixed collection with Lian (2021), on antimony halides. Morrison illustrations continue in parallel. The latest folder scan found 13,984 document copies; later-arrival papers remain outside the fixed deadline collection.

Evans complete main/SI contribution published and anonymously verified: dataset 0.25.0, 512 records, 101 routes/variants and 44 material/component collections. All 46 operation controls and the species 9 viewer were checked; the molecular CIF is not a quantum-dot structure. Morrison source and structured-data audits passed; illustrations continue.

Evans apparatus audit passed all 46 scenes and 153 conditions. Morrison complete source extraction was frozen after all 27 main/SI pages and 30 selected crops were inspected; independent scientific review remains active. No new scientific records published by this progress update.

Evans structured records/reader and molecular source bindings passed separate audits. Forty-six operation diagrams entered independent review. Morrison CdSe/CdS shell-growth paper was admitted through the fixed-cutoff evidence-ranked queue and is being extracted alongside a distinct source reviewer.

Heo contribution published and anonymously verified: dataset 0.24.0, 480 records, 98 routes/variants and 44 material/component collections. The complete 1,209-row SI reader and qualified average-occupancy CIF are included; the original five-paper pilot is 5/5 published.
Heo molecular identities and exact material/stock bindings passed their scoped independent audit after a source-page locator correction. Canonical corrections and website integration remain pending.

Corpus screening refreshed and fixed-cutoff selection activated. A rolling review slot admitted Evans 2010 alongside Heo; original four published batch contributions and their audits remain unchanged.
Heo complete SI aggregation and average-position/occupancy model passed scoped independent checks. Two SI signs and source geometry/recipe discrepancies remain explicit.
Latest saved corpus scan found 13,786 document copies across the incoming and original collections; 9,469 provisional scopes were waiting and one paper was active.

workflow.summary: Independent document screening, then detailed review of useful synthesis/structure evidence.
workflow.screening_scope: Main articles and SI are separate screening units. The completed automated nomination pass and previous97provisional-group receipt entries are preserved; no new source reading is claimed by the queue conversion.
steps: Screen every fixed-cutoff document independently; preserve source copies, format holds and prior coverage. Missing companions do not block screening.
Rank measured/refined atomic-structure candidates with usable recipes first; keep phase, size and morphology-linked recipes as a separate useful tier.
Verify recipe–sample–structure evidence within each retained source, and verify source relationships when joining information from different documents.
Retain all screened candidates and gaps; external reference cells, simulations and molecular-precursor coordinates do not become measured product pairs.
Build and publish academic material readers only after the selected paper’s source, data, figure and independent audit gates pass.
workflow.capacity: Parallel rapid source triage and audits of already prepared contributions. Parser recovery is no longer a prerequisite for readable papers.
workflow.paid_processing: The paid API pilot is deferred. Work continues with the existing local setup.
workflow.scheduled_review_frequency: Daily, as set by the user. Published milestone snapshots remain separate from scheduler wakeups.
workflow.screening_count_limit: Includes aliases and prior terminal reuse; no final-disposition or training count implied.

estimate.summary: The prior76group checks took roughly33active parallel-session minutes. A linear scenario for9,500groups is about70active session hours, or about9days at8active session hours/day. This selected-group calculation is not a measured calendar forecast for the new document-first queue; complete curation is additional.
estimate.current_batch: Chen’s complete source extraction has passed its separate audit. Saini’s complete extraction is frozen with audit pending. Both are preserved while collection screening is completed.
notes: One similarly short session per day would imply about125days for the historical9,500group workload. The daily workflow now continues successive batches during a run; continuous or eight-hour daily execution is not guaranteed.

Two mixed batches took 6.7 and 8.8 minutes for nine and ten new initial screens; their separate checks took 4.8 and 4.3 minutes. These are selected readable sources, not a representative corpus benchmark.
Initial screening, complete extraction, independent scientific audit, website integration and training admission have different completion gates.
Duplicate receipt reuse saves repeated reading only when exact source identity and inspected coverage match; it is not an extra completed paper.
A file labelled as the main article was verified to be a Peer Review File; the true main remains held while useful SI preparation information is retained.
Additional GPU capacity is not established as the bottleneck. An API pilot remains deferred; no paid processing or source upload was started.
Daily scheduling is preserved. A daily wakeup does not establish continuous execution or a fixed number of processing hours.
